data.titulo: Foa 3—Yigyibiti Ɛlielɛ Kɔdwu Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Mɔɔ Lumua La Azo
data.contenido:
Mosisi lile Yizilayɛma anyunlu vile Yigyibiti nlɔnu hɔdwule Saenae Boka ne abo, ɛleka mɔɔ Nyamenle vale ye mɛla ne manle bɛ la. Amozii Mosisi zoanle menli 12 kɛ bɛhɔnlea Keena azɛlɛ ne. Na nuhua 10 vale amaneɛbɔlɛ ɛtane rale. Bɛmanle menli ne hulole kɛ bɛkɛzia bɛkɛhɔ Yigyibiti. Ɔlua diedi mɔɔ bɛannyia ye la ati, Nyamenle deanle Yizilayɛma ne na ɔmanle bɛkpɔsale fienemgbole ne anu toonwo ɛvolɛ 40.

Awieleɛ kolaa ne, bɛkpale Dwɔhyua kɛ ɔli Yizilayɛma anyunlu ɔva bɛ ɔhɔ Keena azɛlɛ ne azo. Amaa bɛahola bɛava azɛlɛ ne la, Gyihova yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Ɔmanle Azule Dwɔdan ne gyakyile ɛzenlɛ, ɔmanle Gyɛleko bane ne dele guale, yɛɛ ɔmanle sɛnzɛne ne gyinlanle ɛleka ko alehyenlɛ muala. Ɛvolɛ nsia anzi, bɛliele azɛlɛ ne bɛvile Keenama asa anu.

Ɔvi Dwɔhyua anwo zo, ndɛnebuavolɛma lile Yizilayɛma anwo zo ɛvolɛ 356. Yɛde bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo, mɔɔ le kɛ Balake, Gedɛyɔn, Gyɛfeta, Samesɛn nee Samoɛle la anwo edwɛkɛ. Eza Yɛkenga mraalɛ le kɛ Releehabe, Dɛbola, Gyeeyɛle, Wulutu, Nawome nee Dɛlaela anwo edwɛkɛ. Wɔ ɔ muala anu, ɛvolɛ 356 anu tetedwɛkɛ a wɔ Foa NSA ne anu a.

ƐBAHOLA wɔahile deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛsesa ye wɔ azɛlɛ ne anwo la ɔ? Ɔle kɛ ɛbɔndwoba anzɛɛ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ bolɔgo la. Ɔle fufule ndɛbandɛba. Noko tɛ ɛbɔndwoba ɔ; ɔle debie mɔɔ bɛdi.

Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti la kɛyɛ siane ko ɛ. Bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu. Aleɛ biala ɛnle ɛke, ɔti menli ne dendɛle bɛ nzo abo hanle kɛ: ‘Yɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ Gyihova hunle yɛ wɔ Yigyibiti. Ɛkɛ ne yɛnyianle aleɛ biala mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ la.’

Ɔti Gyihova hanle kɛ: ‘Mebamaa aleɛ vi anwuma adɔ amaa bɛ.’ Na ɛhye yɛɛ Gyihova yɛle a. Aleɛ hyenle la Yizilayɛma ne nwunle deɛ nwonwohyee ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ ɛgua la, bɛbizebizale bɛ nwo kɛ: ‘Duzu debie ɛ?’

Mosisi zele bɛ kɛ: ‘Ɔle aleɛ mɔɔ Gyihova ɛva ɛmaa bɛ kɛ bɛli a.’ Menli ne vɛlɛle ye MANA. Ye fɛlɛko le kɛ keeki ndɛbandɛba mɔɔ bɛva wolɛ bɛyɛ la.

Mosisi hanle hilele menli ne kɛ: ‘Awie biala ɛsesa dɔɔnwo biala mɔɔ kɛza ye di la.’ Ɔti nwonlomɔ biala bɛsesale bie. Na saa ewia ne fi kpole a ɛnee mana ne mɔɔ hale azɛlɛ ne anwo la ɛholo.

Eza Mosisi hanle hilele bɛ kɛ: ‘Awie biala mmafa bie sie ɔmaa aleɛ kye zolɛ.’ Noko bie mɔ andie. Ɛze mɔɔ zile a? Aleɛ hyenle la mana ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛziele la lɔle azonlɛ, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbɔ! Noko akee, kenle ko wɔ dapɛne ne anu mɔɔ Gyihova hanle hilele menli ne kɛ bɛsesa mana ne mɔnwo. Yemɔ a le kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsia la. Gyihova hanle hilele bɛ kɛ bɛva bie bɛzie, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛmaa bie ɛnrɛdɔ kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsuu la. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale mana ne bie bɛziele la yeannɔ azonlɛ yɛɛ yeambɔ noko! Ɛhye le nwanwane debie bieko!

Ɛvolɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma lile wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la amuala Gyihova manle bɛ mana manle bɛlile.Adendulɛ 16:1-36; Ɛdianlɛ 11:7-⁠9; Dwɔhyua 5:10-12. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

KƐYƐ siane nwiɔ anzi mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne vile Yigyibiti la, bɛradwule Saenae Boka ne, mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Hɔlɛbe la abo. Ɛke a le ɛleka ko ne ala mɔɔ Gyihova dendɛle vile ndile ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛsɔ la anu hilele Mosisi a. Menli ne zokoɛle ɛke na bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne ekyii.

Mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛkendɛ wɔ boka ne abo la, Mosisi vole hɔle boka ne azo. Wɔ boka ne azo, Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ Ɔkulo kɛ Yizilayɛma ne tie Ye na bɛyɛ Ye menli titile. Mosisi dwule rale la, ɔhanle mɔɔ Gyihova ɛha la ɔhilele Yizilayɛma ne. Menli ne noko hanle kɛ bɛbadie Gyihova, ɔluakɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ ye menli.

Akee Gyihova yɛle nwanwane debie. Ɔmanle boka ne azo dule esike, na maanle nu hulule. Eza ɔdendɛle ɔhilele menli ne kɛ: ‘Mame a mele Gyihova bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti’ la. Akee ɔzele kɛ: ‘Bɛmmasonle nyamenle gyɛne biala kɛ me ngome ala.’

Nyamenle vale mɛla ngɔnla bokale mɛla ɛhye anwo ɔmanle Yizilayɛma ne mɔ. Menli ne zulole kpole. Bɛzele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Wɔmɔ tendɛ kile yɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛsulo kɛ Nyamenle tendɛ kile yɛ a yɛbawu.’

Amozii Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Bɛla me nwo ɛke wɔ boka ye azo. Mebava awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ mɔɔ mehɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔɔ mekulo kɛ menli ne di zolɛ wɔ zolɛ la meamaa wɔ.’ Mosisi eza hɔle boka ne azo bieko. Ɔlile nɔɔzo nee ewiazo kenle 40 wɔ ɛkɛ.

Ɛnee Nyamenle lɛ mɛla dɔɔnwo maa ye menli ne. Mosisi hɛlɛle mɛla ne amuala. Eza Nyamenle vale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne manle Mosisi. Nyamenle mumua ne hɛlɛle mɛla 10 ne mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele menli ne la wɔ zolɛ. Bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Mɛla Bulu.

Mɛla Bulu ne anwo hyia kpalɛ. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɛla gyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale manle Yizilayɛma ne mɔ la noko anwo hyia a. Mɛla ne anu ko a le kɛ: ‘Fa wɔ ahonle muala, wɔ ɛkɛla muala, nee wɔ adwenle muala kulo Gyihova wɔ Nyamenle ne.’ Bieko a le kɛ: ‘Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo.’ Gyisɛse Kelaese, Nyamenle Ara ne, zele kɛ Gyihova mɛla mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle ye menli Yizilayɛma la, nwiɔ ɛhye a le titile kpalɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia a. Amozii yɛbazukoa Nyamenle Ara ne nee ye ngilehilelɛ ne anwo ninyɛne dɔɔnwo.Adendulɛ 19:1-25; 20:1-21; 24:12-18; 31:18; Mɛla ne 6:4-⁠6; Sɛlɛvolɛma 19:18; Mateyu 22:36-40. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

OO, OO! Duzu a menli ne ɛlɛyɛ la? Bɛlɛsonle ɛnlankɛ ralɛ! Duzu ati a bɛlɛyɛ ɛhye a?

Mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi hyɛle wɔ boka ne azo na ɔmba la, menli ne zele kɛ: ‘Yɛnze mɔɔ ɛzi Mosisi anwo zo a. Yemɔti bɛmaa yɛyɛ nyamenle na ɔli yɛ nyunlu yɛvi azɛlɛ ɛhye azo.’

Mosisi adiema Aalɔn zele bɛ kɛ: ‘Mede. Bɛyeye bɛ ezukoa nvutuke asomadeɛ ne mɔ bɛrɛlɛ me.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne yeyele rale la, Aalɔn holole guale nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ. Na menli ne hanle kɛ: ‘Yɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti la ɛne!’ Akee Yizilayɛma ne mɔ dole ɛkponle kpole bie, na bɛzonlenle nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ne.

Mɔɔ Gyihova nwunle ɛhye la, ɔvale ɛya kpole. Yemɔti ɔhanle ɔhilele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Maa ɔyɛ ndɛndɛ tolo kɔ. Menli ne mɔ ɛlɛyɛ ɛtane kpole. Bɛkpo me mɛla ne na bɛlɛsonle nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ.’ Mosisi tolole boka ne ndɛndɛ. Na mɔɔ ɔbikyele bɛ la, mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la ɛne. Menli ne ɛlɛto edwɛne na bɛlɛsi agole bɛabɔ nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ne anwo mgbɔlɛka bayia! Mosisi vale ɛya kpole na ɔvuandinle awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔɔ mɛla ne wɔ zolɛ la ɔguale aze, ɔbubule bɛ bɔkɔɔ. Akee ɔvale nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ne na ɔholole ye. Akee ɔdinle ɔmanle ɔyɛle motomoto kɛ pawoda.

Menli ne ɛyɛ ɛtane kpole kpalɛ. Ɔti Mosisi hanle hilele mrenya ne mɔ bie kɛ bɛva bɛ dadeɛ ne mɔ. Mosisi zele kɛ: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ menli mɔɔ zonlenle nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ne la kɔsɔɔti wu.’ Yemɔti mrenya ne mɔ hunle menli ne anu 3,000! Asoo ɛhye ɛngile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnea boɛ kɛ yɛbazonle Gyihova angomekye, na yɛnrɛzonle adalɛ nyamenle biala ɔ?Adendulɛ 32:1-35. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛze mɔɔ bɛfa sua ɛhye bɛyɛ la ɔ? Ɔle ɛdanlɛ sua titile bie mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsonle Gyihova a. Eza bɛfɛlɛ ye ɛzonlenlɛ sua. Menli ne vile Yigyibiti la ye ɛvolɛ ko anzi yɛɛ bɛwiele ye si a. Asoo ɛze ahenle mɔɔ ɔmanle bɛzile a?

Gyihova ɔ. Mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi wɔ Saenae Boka ne azo la, Gyihova hilele ye kɛzi ɔzi ye la. Ɔhanle kɛ ɔyɛ ye mɔɔ bɛtudu a bɛnvɛ nwolɛ a. Wɔ zɛhae adenle ye azo bɛbahola bɛadudu na bɛazoa bɛahɔ ɛleka fofolɛ na bɛazi ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Yemɔti Yizilayɛma ne mɔ zoale ɛdanlɛ sua ne hɔle ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛdule bɛhɔle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ fienemgbole ne anu la.

Saa ɛnea ekpumgbunli ekyi ne mɔɔ wɔ sua ne ati lɔ la anu a, ɛbanwu ɛlɛka bie wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛfɛlɛ ye ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka. Bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ anwumabɔvolɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ kyɛlɛbo bɛzie nduazo ne ati nee ɔ ti. Nyamenle eza hɛlɛle Mɛla Bulu ne mɔɔ Mosisi bubule ye la bieko guale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ azo. Na bɛvale awolɛ ɛhye mɔ bɛziele ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne anu. Eza noko bɛvale mana ne bie bɛguale dwora nu bɛziele nu. Asoo ɛkakye mana ne deɛ holɛ ɔ?

Gyihova kpale Mosisi adiema nrenya Aalɔn kɛ ɛsɔfo kpanyinli. Ɔdi menli ne anyunlu ɔmaa bɛzonle Gyihova. Na ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ noko le ɛsɔfoma.

Akee nea ɛdanlɛ sua ne ekpumgbunli kpole ne. Ye kpole le ekpumgbunli ekyi ne mɔnwo nwiɔ. Ɛnwu ɛlɛka ekyi ne mɔɔ esike vi nu la ɔ? Ɛhye a le afɔlemokyea ne mɔɔ ɛsɔfo ne mɔ yela ayile evuanlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ɛyɛlɛ la wɔ zolɛ a. Akee kɛnlaneɛ baka mɔɔ kɛnlaneɛ ngoko nsuu wɔ zolɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Debie mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa wɔ ekpumgbunli ne anu la a le ɛkponle. Bɛfa kpanwo 12 bɛgua zolɛ. Kyɛnze kpole mɔɔ nzule wɔ nuhua la wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne alie nwo. Ɛsɔfo ne mɔ fa wowo bɛ nwo. Afɔlemokyea kpole ne noko wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɛke a bɛyela nane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔle bɛmaa Gyihova a. Ɛdanlɛ sua ne wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne avinli, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma ne mɔ dede bɛ ɛdanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu ɛbɔ nwolɛ mgbɔlɛka ɛyia.Adendulɛ 25:8-40; 26:1-37; 27:1-⁠8; 28:⁠1; 30:1-10, 17-21; 34:1, 2; Hibuluma 9:1-⁠5. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA baka ma ne mɔɔ mrenya ɛhye mɔ zo la. Nea kɛzi vanye ne taakɛ le mgbole la. Ye ɛnlomboɛ ti, menli nwiɔ a gyɛnva na bɛahola ye soa a. Nea feege ma ne. Baka ma ngɛnlɛma ɛhye vi ni? Ɔvi Keena azɛlɛ zo. Kakye kɛ Ebileham, Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo dɛnlanle Keena wɔ mekɛ bie anu. Noko ɔlua ɛhɔne ne mɔɔ zile ɛkɛ ne la ati Gyekɔbo ne ye abusua ne dule hɔdɛnlanle Yigyibiti. Akee ye ɛvolɛ 216 anzi, Mosisi ɛlɛfa Yizilayɛma azia ahɔ Keena. Bɛradwu fienemgbole ne anu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Keedɛhye la.

Ɛtanevolɛma wɔ Keena azɛlɛ ne azo. Yemɔti Mosisi zoanle menli 12 na ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔnlea menli dodo mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la na bɛnlea kɛzi bɛ anwosesebɛ de la. Bɛnlea saa azɛlɛ ne kye aleɛ a. Na bɛva nehane mbaka ma ne bie bɛrɛla.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ busiama ne mɔ ziale rale Keedɛhye la, bɛzele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Azɛlɛ ne kye aleɛ bɔkɔɔ.’ Bɛvale ɛkɛ ne baka ma ne bie bɛhilele Mosisi. Noko busiama ne anu 10 hanle kɛ: ‘Menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la le mgbole na bɛ nwo yɛ se kpalɛ. Saa yɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛfa bɛ azɛlɛ ne a bɛbahu yɛ muala.’

Yizilayɛma ne zulole kpole wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la. Bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ anrɛɛ yɛwule Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo anzɛɛ wɔ fienemgbole ɛhye anu. Yɛbawuwu dadeɛ nloa na bahye yɛ mraalɛ nee yɛ mra nuokɛ. Bɛmaa yɛye kpanyinli fofolɛ yɛmaa ɔli yɛ ti na yɛzia yɛhɔ Yigyibiti!’

Noko busiama ne anu nwiɔ lɛ anwodozo wɔ Gyihova anu na bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛbodo menli ne. Bɛmɛ a le Dwɔhyua nee Kalɛbe. Bɛzele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛmmasulo. Gyihova ne yɛ lua. Ɔnrɛyɛ se kɛ yɛkɛva azɛlɛ ne.’ Noko menli ne andie. Anrɛɛ bɛku Dwɔhyua nee Kalɛbe bɔbɔ.

Ɛhye manle Gyihova vale ɛya kpole, na ɔhanle ɔhilele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Menli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ 20 mɔɔ kɔ la biala agyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia Keena azɛlɛ ne azo. Bɛnwu me nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ menyɛle ye wɔ Yigyibiti nee fienemgbole ne anu la noko akee bɛanlie me bɛanli. Yemɔti bɛbaluolua fienemgbole ye anu ɛvolɛ 40 kɔkpula kɛ mɔɔ li amozi kolaa la bawu. Dwɔhyua nee Kalɛbe ala a bahɔ Keena azɛlɛ ne azo a.’Ɛdianlɛ 13:1-33; 14:1-38. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA ndotolo ne nee alemɔn bolora ne mɔɔ efifi baka ɛhye azo la. Aalɔn baka ne ɛne. Ndotolo ne nee ma ne mɔɔ ɛbolo la rale kenle ko nɔɔzo ala! Maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔrale ye zɔ la.

Yizilayɛma ne mɔ ɛkpɔsɛkpɔsa fienemgbole ne anu ɛhyɛ ekyii. Menli ne bie mɔ zuzule kɛ Mosisi ɛnfɛta kɛ ɔkɛli bɛ nyunlu, anzɛɛ Aalɔn kɛyɛ ɛsɔfo kpanyinli. Ɛnee Kɔla dwenle zɔ, na zɔhane ala yɛɛ Deetan, Abaelam nee mgbanyinli 250 noko dwenlenle a. Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala rahanle hilele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a bɛvo bɛdɛnla yɛ muala yɛ nwo zo zɛhae a?’

Mosisi hanle hilele Kɔla nee ɔ sa zo ne mɔ kɛ: ‘Ɛhyema nwonlomɔ bɛva ahyɛnze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ la na bɛva ɛyɛlɛ bɛgua nu. Akee bɛva bɛrɛla Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anyunlu. Yɛbanwu mɔɔ Gyihova baye ye la.’

Aleɛ hyenle la Kɔla nee ɔ sa zo menli 250 ne rale ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anyunlu. Menli dɔɔnwo noko rale kɛ bɛbazi menli ɛhye mɔ adua. Gyihova vale ɛya kpole. Mosisi zele menli ne kɛ: ‘Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anwo. Bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka bɛ debie biala.’ Menli ne diele na bɛhwenle bɛ nwo bɛvile Kɔla, Deetan nee Abaelam ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anwo.

Akee Mosisi se: ‘Ɛhye bamaa bɛanwu mɔɔ Gyihova ɛye ye la. Azɛlɛ ne bakpakye na yeame menli ɛtanevolɛ ɛhye mɔ.’

Mɔɔ Mosisi wiele tendɛ ala la, azɛlɛ ne kpakyele. Kɔla ɛdanlɛ sua ne nee ye ninyɛne, nee Deetan nee Abaelam nee menli mɔɔ boka bɛ nwo la kɔsɔɔti wolole azɛlɛ ne anu na ɔhedale bɛ nwo zo. Mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne dele menli mɔɔ ɛlɛwolo azɛlɛ ne anu la ɛzunlɛ ne la bɛdeanle nuhua kɛ: ‘Angɔ a angɔ o! Wɔannea a azɛlɛ ne kɛme yɛdayɛ noko o!’

Ɛnee Kɔla nee ɔ sa zo menli 250 ne tɛbɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anwo. Yemɔti Gyihova manle senle vi anwuma rayelale bɛ muala. Akee Gyihova hanle hilele Aalɔn ara nrenya Ɛlieza kɛ ɔyeye menli mɔɔ ɛwu la ɛyɛlɛkpunlɛ ahyɛnze ne mɔ na ɔbolo bɛ ɛdɛbaa na bɛava bɛaheda afɔlemokyea ne azo. Ɛhye bayɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ amaa Yizilayɛma ne mɔ kɛ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ala a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ ɛsɔfo maa Gyihova a.

Noko akee ɛnee Gyihova kulo kɛ ɔda ye ali wienyi kɛ Aalɔn ne ɔ mra ne mɔ ala a yekpa bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛsɔfo a. Yemɔti ɔhanle ɔhilele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Maa Yizilayɛ abusua kpanyinli biala ɛva ye baka ɛrɛla. Maa Aalɔn ɛva Livae abusua ne baka ɛdeɛ ne ɛrɛla. Na fa mbaka ɛhye mɔ gua ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne anyunlu wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Sonla ne mɔɔ menlea nu meye ye la baka ɛdeɛ ne bafifi.’

Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ ne mɔɔ Mosisi hɔnleanle la, nea, Aalɔn baka ne ɛfefɛ nya, ɛbɔ ndotolo na yezo alemɔn ma mɔɔ ɛbolo a! Akee wɔnwu deɛ mɔɔ ɔti Gyihova manle Aalɔn baka ne bɔle ndotolo la ɔ?Ɛdianlɛ 16:1-49; 17:1-11; 26:10. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐVOLƐ dɔɔnwo ɛze ɛhɔ—ɛvolɛ 10, ɛvolɛ 20, ɛvolɛ 30, ɛvolɛ 39! Na Yizilayɛma tɛbɔ fienemgbole ne anu. Noko Gyihova nleanle ye menli ne mɔ wɔ ɛvolɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala anu. Ɔmanle bɛlile mana. Ɔvale amungu pila ɔlile bɛ nyunlu alehyenlɛ nu, na ɔmanle senle pila lile bɛ nyunlu nɔɔzo. Ɛvolɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala anu bɛ adɛladeɛ nee bɛ ndanlɛ antete yɛɛ bɛ gyakɛ anyɛ nganlɛ.

Bɛvile Yigyibiti la ye siane mɔɔ lumua wɔ ɛvolɛ 40 ne anu la ɛne. Yizilayɛma ne razokoɛle Keedɛhye bieko. Ɛke yɛɛ ɛnee bɛwɔ mɔɔ busiama 12 ne hɔkpɔlale Keena azɛlɛ ne azo kɛyɛ ɛvolɛ 40 mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la. Mosisi adiema raalɛ Meleam wule wɔ Keedɛhye. Na kɛmɔ ɔde ye dɛba la, eza bɛyiale ngyegyelɛ bieko wɔ ɛke.

Menli ne ɛnnyia nzule. Yemɔti bɛzele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Saa yɛwule bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ ɔle kpalɛ. Duzu ati a bɛye yɛ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛ nee yɛ ɛra munzule azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛhwee ɛnfifi zolɛ la azo a? Feege, vanye anzɛɛ ma mɔɔ le kɛ akutue la biala ɛnle ɛke. Nzule bɔbɔ mɔɔ yɛno la ɛbɔ yɛ.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi nee Aalɔn hɔle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu hɔyɛle asɔne la, Gyihova zele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Boɔboa menli ne kɔsɔɔti anloa. Na wɔ bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne tendɛ kile bodane ne mɔɔ la bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la. Na nzule dɔɔnwo vi nu bara na wɔanyia nzule wɔamaa menli ne nee bɛ nyɛmoa anlo.’

Ɔti Mosisi boɔboale ɛlɔne ne anloa na ɔzele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛdie, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie Nyamenle bɛ nli la! Asoo bodane ɛhye anu yɛɛ me nee Aalɔn banyia nzule amaa bɛ ɔ?’ Akee Mosisi vale ye kpɔma ne bɔle bodane ne fane nwiɔ, na nzule dɔɔnwo vi nuhua rale. Menli ne nee bɛ nyɛmoa ne mɔ nyianle nzule dɔɔnwo nlonle.

Noko, Gyihova vale Mosisi nee Aalɔn anwo ɛya. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔvale ɛya la ɔ? Ɔluakɛ Mosisi nee Aalɔn hanle kɛ bɛdabɛ yɛɛ bɛbamaa nzule avi bodane ne anu ara a. Noko Gyihova a yɛle a. Ɔluakɛ Mosisi nee Aalɔn anga nɔhalɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo la ati, Gyihova zele kɛ ɔbadea bɛ. Ɔse: ‘Bɛnrɛli me menli ne ati bɛnrɛhɔ Keena.’

Yeangyɛ biala Yizilayɛma ne vile Keedɛhye. Mekɛ guale nu ekyii la bɛradwule Hɔɔ Boka ne abo. Aalɔn wule wɔ ɛke, wɔ boka ne azo. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwule la ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ 123. Yizilayɛma ne lile alɔbɔlɛ na bɛzunle Aalɔn toonwo kenle kɔkɔlɛ 30. Ɔ ra Ɛlieza rayɛle Yizilayɛ maanle ne ɛsɔfo kpanyinli.Ɛdianlɛ 20:1-13, 22-29; Mɛla ne 29:⁠5; Nihɛmaya 9:21. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛhye zɔho ɛwɔlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛbeba baka ne anwo ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ. Bɛva kɔbele a bɛyɛ ɛwɔlɛ ne a. Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ ɔva ɔhenda baka zo amaa menli ne anlea na bɛanyia ngoane. Noko nwɔlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne anwo la le nwɔlɛ mgbalɛ. Bɛkeka menli ne mɔ, na bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛdo bɛ. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti yera ye zɔ la ɔ?

Yizilayɛma ne mɔ ɛdendɛ ɛtia Nyamenle nee Mosisi la ati ɔ. Bɛse: ‘Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛva yɛ bɛvi Yigyibiti kɛ yɛrawu wɔ fienemgbole ye anu ɛ? Nzule nee aleɛ bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛke. Mana aleɛ funli ɛhye yɛnrɛhola bieko di.’

Noko mana ne le aleɛ kpalɛ. Gyihova lua nwanwane adenle zo a yeva yemaa bɛ a. Eza ɔlua nwanwane adenle zo a yemaa bɛ nzule a. Noko menli ne angile anyezɔlɛ wɔ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ɛmaa bɛ la anwo. Ɔti Gyihova zoanle nwɔlɛ anwo ɛzulolɛ ɛhye mɔ vale hwenle Yizilayɛma anzo. Nwɔlɛ ne mɔ kekale bɛ na bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo wule.

Awieleɛ kolaa ne menli ne rale Mosisi anwo ɛkɛ ne, na bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Yɛyɛ ɛtane, ɔluakɛ yɛdendɛ yɛtia Gyihova nee ɛdawɔ. Sɛlɛ Gyihova maa ɔmaa nwɔlɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛhɔ.’ Yemɔti Mosisi zɛlɛle manle menli ne. Na Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ kɔbele ɛwɔlɛ ɛhye. Ɔse ɔva ɔhenda baka zo, na ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ ɛwɔlɛ kɛha ye la nea. Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle hanle hilele ye la. Na menli mɔɔ ɛwɔlɛ hale bɛ la dole bɛ nye nleanle kɔbele ɛwɔlɛ ne na bɛdele kpɔkɛ bieko.

Yɛsukoa debie yɛfi ɛhye anu. Wɔ adenle bie azo, yɛ muala yɛle kɛ Yizilayɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ nwɔlɛ ne kekale bɛ la. Yɛ muala yɛlɛwu. To ɛ nye nea ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la, na ɛbanwu ye kɛ menli yɛ mgbanyinli, bɛ nwo to bɛ, na bɛwu. Ɔluakɛ raalɛ nee nrenya mɔɔ lumua la, Adam nee Yive hwenle bɛ nwo vile Gyihova adehilelɛ bo, na yɛdayɛ noko yɛle bɛ mra la ati a yera ye zɔ a. Noko Gyihova ɛyɛ nziezielɛ mɔɔ bamaa yɛadɛnla aze dahuu a.

Gyihova zoanle ɔ Ra, Gyesɛse Kelaese, rale azɛlɛ ye azo. Bɛhendanle Gyesɛse wɔ baka zo, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo suzu kɛ ɔle ɛtanevolɛ. Noko Gyihova vale Gyesɛse manle kɛ ɔlie yɛ ngoane. Saa yɛfa yɛ nwo yɛto ɔ nwo zo, na yɛdi ɔ nzi a, yɛbahola yɛanyia dahuu ngoane. Yɛbazukoa ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo amozii.Ɛdianlɛ 21:4-⁠9; Dwɔn 3:14, 15. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

WƆDE kɛ asoaso bie ɛdendɛ ɛlɛ ɔ? Bie a ɛbaha kɛ, ‘Kyɛkyɛ, nane ɛndendɛ.’ Noko Baebolo ne ka asoaso bie mɔɔ ɔdendɛle la anwo edwɛkɛ. Maa yɛnlea kɛzi ɔrale ye zɔ la.

Ɛnee asɛɛ Yizilayɛma ne ɛdwu Keena azɛlɛ ne azo. Mowabema belemgbunli Beelake ɛnee sulo Yizilayɛma ne mɔ. Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛhɔvale nrenya nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Beelam la kɛ ɔrawa Yizilayɛma amonle. Beelake bɔle Beelam ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbamaa ye ezukoa dɔɔnwo, ɔti Beelam vole dɛnlanle ye asoaso ne azo na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkɔ Beelake ɛkɛ.

Ɛnee Gyihova ɛngulo kɛ Beelam kɛwa Ye menli ne amonle. Yemɔti ɔmanle ye anwumabɔvolɛ vale dadeɛ tendenle bie hɔgyinlanle adenle ne anu kɛ ɔzi Beelam adenle. Beelam ɛnnwu anwumabɔvolɛ ne, noko ye asoaso ne nwu ye. Ɔti asoaso ne bɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔtwe ɔ nwo ahane yeavi anwumabɔvolɛ ne anyunlu, na amozii ɔbutule adenle ne anu. Beelam vale ɛya kpole, na ɔvale baka ɔfinle ye asoaso ne.

Akee Gyihova manle Beelam dele kɛ ye asoaso ne ɛlɛtendɛ ahile ye. Asoaso ne bizale ye kɛ: ‘Duzu bɔbɔ yɛɛ meyɛ wɔ mɔɔ yemɔti wɔfi me a?’

Beelam buale ye kɛ: ‘Wɔyɛ me koasea. Saa, melɛ dadeɛ a anrɛɛ mehu wɔ!’

Asoaso ne bizale ye kɛ: ‘Asoo meyɛ wɔ zɛhae ɛlɛ?’

Beelam buale kɛ: ‘kyɛkyɛ.’

Akee Gyihova manle Beelam nwunle anwumabɔvolɛ ne kɛ ɔlɛ dadeɛ ɔgyi adenle ne anu. Anwumabɔvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a wɔfi wɔ asoaso ne ɛ? Mera kɛ mebazi wɔ aze, ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛkɔwa Yizilayɛma amonle. Saa wɔ asoaso ne anyɛ zɔhane a anrɛɛ mehu wɔ, na megyakyi wɔ asoaso ne.’

Beelam buale kɛ: ‘Meyɛ ɛtane. Menze kɛ ɛgyi adenle ne anu.’ Anwumabɔvolɛ ne manle Beelam hɔle, na Beelam hɔnwunle Beelake. Ɔbɔle mɔdenle bieko kɛ ɔwa Yizilayɛ amonle, noko akee, Gyihova manle ɔyilalɛ Yizilayɛ fane nsa.Ɛdianlɛ 21:21-35; 22:1-40; 23:1-30; 24:1-25. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MOSISI kulo kɛ ɔ nee Yizilayɛma kɔ Keena. Ɔti ɔzɛlɛle kɛ: ‘Gyihova, maa mempɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne, na mengɔnwu azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne.’ Na Gyihova buale ye kɛ: ‘Yeyɛ boɛ! Mmaka ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ bieko ɛkile me!’ Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti Gyihova buale ye zɔ la ɔ?

Ɔlua mɔɔ ɔzile wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi bɔle bolɛ ne la ati ɔ. Kakye kɛ, ɔ nee Aalɔn anva anyunlunyia ammaa Gyihova. Bɛanga bɛangile menli ne kɛ Gyihova yɛɛ ɛlɛfa nzule avi bodane ne anu amaa bɛ a. Ɔlua ɛhye ati Gyihova hanle kɛ ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛhɔ Keena.

Yemɔti Aalɔn wule na mekɛ guale nu ekyii la, Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ: ‘Ye Dwɔhyua na maa ɔgyinla ɛsɔfo Ɛlieza nee menli ne anyunlu. Na kpakye nu ka maa bɛ muala bɛde kɛ Dwɔhyua a le bɛ adekilevolɛ fofolɛ ne a.’ Kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ne anu la, Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ Gyihova hanle la pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Akee Gyihova hanle hilele Dwɔhyua kɛ: ‘Mmasulo, gyinla kpundii. Ɛbali Yizilayɛma ati wɔahɔ Keena azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale membɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la azo, na me nee wɔ balua.’

Nzinlii Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ ɔvo ɔhɔ Nibo Boka ne mɔɔ wɔ Mowabe la azo. Wɔ ɛkɛ ne Mosisi bahola anwu Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi na yeanwu Keena azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne. Gyihova zele kɛ: ‘Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale membɔle Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo ɛwɔkɛ kɛ mebava meamaa bɛ bo zo amra la ɛne. Memaa ɛ nye nwiɔ ɛnwu ye, noko menrɛmaa ɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia zolɛ.’

Mosisi wule wɔ Nibo Boka ne azo. Ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ 120. Ɛnee ɔtɛdɛ anwosesebɛ, na ɔ nye noko nwu debie kpalɛ. Menli ne lile alɔbɔlɛ na bɛzunle ɔboalekɛ Mosisi ɛwu. Noko bɛ nye liele kɛ Dwɔhyua ɛrayɛ bɛ adekilevolɛ fofolɛ a.Ɛdianlɛ 27:12-23; Mɛla ne 3:23-29; 31:1-8, 14-23; 32:45-52; 34:1-12. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MENLI ɛhye wɔ esiane nu. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnriandi, tɛ ye zɔhane a bɛbahu bɛ. Bɛle Yizilayɛ busiama, na raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛboa bɛ la a le Releehabe. Releehabe de sua bie mɔɔ bɛzi ye wɔ suakpole Gyɛleko bane ne azo la anu. Maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti menli ɛhye wɔ esiane nu la.

Ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛziezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛkapɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne bɛahɔ Keena azɛlɛ ne azo. Noko kolaa na bɛahɔ la, Dwɔhyua zoanle busiama nwiɔ ne. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔli busia na bɛnleɛnlea kɛ azɛlɛ ne nee suakpole Gyɛleko si de la.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ busiama ne dwule Gyɛleko la, bɛhɔle Releehabe sua nu. Na awie hɔhanle hilele Gyɛleko belemgbunli ne kɛ: ‘Yizilayɛma nwiɔ bie ɛra ɛke nɔsolɛ ye ala kɛ bɛbanleɛnlea maanle ye anu.’ Belemgbunli ne dele ala la, ɔzoanle menli wɔ Releehabe ɛkɛ ne na bɛzele ye kɛ: ‘Fa menli ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ sua ne anu la, bɛla ɛke!’ Noko mekɛ zɔhane ɛnee Releehabe ɛva menli ne ɛhɔvea ye sua ne ati zo anwuma. Ɔti ɔbuale bɛ kɛ: ‘Menli bie rale me sua nu ɛke ɛdeɛ, noko menze ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvi a. Bɛziale na sɛnzɛne ne adɔ, kolaa na bɛado suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anu. Saa bɛkpo bɛ a, bɛbahɔdo bɛ adenle nu!’ Yemɔti menli ne bɔle ɔ bo kpole bɛ.

Bɛhɔle ala la, Releehabe nriandile hɔle sua ne ati zo. Ɔzele busiama ne kɛ: ‘Meze kɛ Gyihova bava azɛlɛ ɛhye amaa bɛ. Yɛde kɛzi ɔmanle Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne sesanle bɔkɔɔ manle bɛpɛle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛlɛba la, nee kɛzi bɛhunle Ɔɔgo nee Saehɔn arelemgbunli ne mɔ la. Meyɛ bɛ boɛ, ɔti mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛbɔ me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛlo me. Bɛlie egya nee ɔmɔ, me mediema mrenya nee mraalɛ ngoane.’

Busiama ne mɔ bɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛyɛ, noko ɔwɔ kɛ Releehabe yɛ nwolɛ debie. Busiama ne zele ye kɛ: ‘Fa nyɛma kɔkɔlɛ ɛhye kenda wɔ nvɛzɛlɛ ne anu, na boɔboa ɛ nwo amra amuala wɔ wɔ aako ye anu. Na saa yɛsia yɛba kɛ yɛbava Gyɛleko a, yɛanwu nyɛma ne wɔ nvɛzɛlɛ ne anu na yɛangu wɔ aako ye anu sonla biala.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ busiama ne ziale hɔle Dwɔhyua anwo lɔ la, bɛhanle mɔɔ zile la amuala bɛhilele ye.Dwɔhyua 2:1-24; Hibuluma 11:31. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA! Yizilayɛma ɛlɛpɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne! Noko nzule ne wɔ nienwu? Ɔluakɛ ɛnee ezule dɔɔnwo tɔ wɔ zɔhane mekɛ ne anu wɔ ɛvolɛ ne anu la ati, ɛnee azule ne yile la ɔtɛkyɛle. Noko kɛkala nzule ne amuala ɛsesa! Na Yizilayɛma lua azɛlɛ resee zo kɛmɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anu la! Nienwu yɛɛ nzule ne amuala ɛhɔ a? Maa yɛnlea.

Mɔɔ mekɛ dwule kɛ Yizilayɛma pɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne la, mɔɔ Gyihova manle Dwɔhyua hanle hilele menli ne la ɛne: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsɔfo ne mɔ fa ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne na bɛdumua bɛ nyunlu. Saa bɛwula bɛ gyakɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne anu a, nzule ne bagyakyi ɛzenlɛ.’

Yemɔti ɛsɔfo ne mɔ vale ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne na bɛlumuale menli ne anyunlu. Bɛhɔdwule Dwɔdan ne anloa la, ɛsɔfo ne mɔ dwule azule ne anu. Ɔle kuma na ɔlɛse kpole kpalɛ. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ gyakɛ hanle nzule ne ala la, azule ne gyakyile ɛzenlɛ! Ɛnee ɔyɛ nwanwane! Gyihova ɛmaa azule ne sɔlɔ ɛpɛ ɛyɛ bonrabonra wɔ ɛleka ko. Yeangyɛ azule ne sesanle yɛle resee! Ɛsɔfo ne mɔ mɔɔ zo ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne la hɔgyinlanle azɛlɛ resee zo wɔ azule ne avinli. Ɛnwu bɛ wɔ nvoninli ne anu ɔ? Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛgyi ɛkɛ ne la Yizilayɛma ne amuala luale azɛlɛ resee zo pɛle Azule Dwɔdan ne! Mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛwiele azule ne pɛ la, Gyihova manle Dwɔhyua hanle hilele mrenya anwosesebɛ 12 kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔ azule ne anu ɛleka mɔɔ ɛsɔfo ne mɔ zo ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne gyi la. Bɛsesa awolɛ 12, bɛhɔgua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbazokoɛ ɛnɛ nɔe la. Saa kenlebie bɛ mra biza mɔɔ ɛhye kile la a, bɛze bɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyihova ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne pɛ Dwɔdan ne la azule ne tikale na ɔgyakyile ɛzenlɛ. Awolɛ ne bahakye bɛ nwanwane deɛ ɛhye!’ Dwɔhyua eza huohuanle awolɛ 12 wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛsɔfo ne mɔ gyinlanle wɔ azule ne anu la.

Awieleɛ kolaa ne Dwɔhyua hanle hilele ɛsɔfo ne mɔ mɔɔ zo ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne la kɛ: ‘Bɛvo bɛhɔ Dwɔdan ne file zo.’ Mɔɔ bɛvole ala la, azule ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔse bieko.Dwɔhyua 3:1-17; 4:1-18. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

DUZU a ɛlɛmaa Gyɛleko bane ne ade agua a? Ɔle kɛ asɛɛ bɛdo bɔmbo kpole bie bɛzi nu. Noko zɔhane mekɛ ne ɛnee bɔmbo ɛnle ɛkɛ ne; ɛnee bɛnlɛ etu bɔbɔ. Gyihova nwanwane gyima bieko ɛne! Maa yɛzukoa kɛzi ɔzile la anwo edwɛkɛ.

Tie mɔɔ Gyihova hanle hilele Dwɔhyua la: ‘Ɛ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema ne mɔ ɛdia kilikili ɛbɔ suakpole ne anwo mgbɔlɛka. Bɛbɔ nwolɛ mgbɔlɛka kenle nsia, kenle ko biala ko. Bɛzoa ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne bɛboka bɛ nwo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsɔfo nsuu di bɛ nyunlu na bɛbɔ bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ.

‘Kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtia kilikili bɛbɔ suakpole ne anwo mgbɔlɛka fane nsuu. Akee bɛbɔ bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ tendenle ko na awie biala ɛdea nu kpole kpalɛ. Na bane ne bade agua aze gɔɔ!’



Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne yɛle kɛmɔ Gyihova zele bɛ la. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtia kilikili la, ɛnee bɛyɛ ngongoonwu. Awie biala amkpo ɛdahonlɛ. Mɔɔ ɛte ala a le aweɛne ne nee bɛ gyakɛ abo kilikili ne. Ɔbayɛ kɛ ɛnee ɛzulolɛ ɛha Nyamenle menli ne agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛleko la. Ɛnwu nyɛma kɔkɔlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhenda nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu la? Nwane nvɛnzɛlɛ ɔ? Ɛhɛe, Releehabe ɛyɛ mɔɔ busiama nwiɔ ne hanle hilele ye kɛ ɔyɛ la. Ɔ nee ye abusua ne amuala wɔ sua ne anu bɛlɛnea mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo la.

Awieleɛ kolaa ne, kenle nsuu ne azo, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdia kilikili bɛbɔ suakpole ne anwo mgbɔlɛka fane nsuu bɛwie la, bɛwule aweɛne ne anu, ɛlɔnema ne deanle nuhua, na bane ne dele guale aze. Akee Dwɔhyua zele kɛ: ‘Bɛzɛkye suakpole ne na bɛhu awie biala mɔɔ wɔ zo la. Bɛyela debie biala. Dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, kɔbele, nee bulalɛ ala a bɛgyakyi a, na bɛva bɛhɔgua Gyihova gya ne anu wɔ ɛdanlɛ sua ne anu.’

Dwɔhyua zele busiama nwiɔ ne kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔ Releehabe sua nu, bɛhɔva ye nee ye mbusua ne bɛvinde.’ Bɛliele Releehabe nee ye abusua ne ngoane, kɛmɔ busiama ne bɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la.Dwɔhyua 6:1-25. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA mɔɔ nrenya ne ɛlɛfu awula ye ɛdanlɛ sua ne anu la! Tɛladeɛ kɛnlɛma, ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma ko, nee dwɛtɛ fufule. Ɔvale ɔvile suakpole Gyɛleko azo. Noko duzu a anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Gyɛleko ninyɛne ne mɔ a? Ɛkakye ɔ?

Ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye ɔ muala, na bɛfa ezukoa nvutuke ne nee dwɛtɛ fufule ne bɛkɔgua Gyihova gya ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la anu. Ɔti menli ɛhye andie Nyamenle. Bɛwua debie mɔɔ le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ la. Bɛfɛlɛ nrenya ne Ekan, na ye abusua ne anu amra bie a boka ɔ nwo la. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ ɔzile la.

Ekan wuale ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ wiele la anzi, Dwɔhyua zoanle menli bie kɛ bɛ nee Eyae ɛhɔho. Noko bɛbole bɛ dwɛɛ. Bɛhunle bie mɔ, na mɔɔ hale la guale ɛbɔ nu. Dwɔhyua lile alɔbɔlɛ kpole. Ɔbutule na ɔzɛlɛle Gyihova kɛ: ‘Duzu ati yɛɛ wɔye yɛ wɔmaa a?’

Gyihova buale kɛ: ‘Dwazo! Yizilayɛ ɛyɛ ɛtane. Bɛva ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛkɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la bie. Bɛwua tɛladeɛ kɛnlɛma bie na bɛva bɛvea. Menrɛyila wɔ kyesɛ ɛsɛkye bɛ, nee ahenle mɔɔ ɔvale ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la.’ Gyihova zele Dwɔhyua kɛ ɔbahile ye zɔhane ɛtanevolɛ ne.

Yemɔti Dwɔhyua boɔboale menli ne kɔsɔɔti anloa, na Gyihova yele Ekan, ɛtanevolɛ ne. Ekan buale kɛ: ‘Meyɛ ɛtane. Menwunle tɛladeɛ kɛnlɛma ne, nee ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma ne yɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ne. Ɔyɛle me kɛnlɛma ɔti menvale. Mevu mewula me ɛdanlɛ sua ne anu.’

Bɛnwunle ninyɛne ne na bɛvale bɛrɛlɛle Dwɔhyua la, ɔzele Ekan kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a wɔva ngyegyelɛ ɛhye wɔdo yɛ nwo ɛ? Gyihova bava bie ado ɛ nwo ɛnɛ!’ Akee menli ne amuala zile Ekan nee ye abusua ne awolɛ na bɛhunle bɛ. Asoo ɛhye ɛngile kɛ ɔnle kɛ yɛfa ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔnle yɛ ɛdeɛ la ɔ?

Ɛhye anzi Yizilayɛma nee Eyae hɔhonle bieko. Akee Gyihova boale ye menli ne mɔ, na bɛlile konim.Dwɔhyua 7:1-26; 8:1-29. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

KEENA azuamgbole ne mɔ akee ɛziezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛ kaho. Bɛsuzu kɛ bɛkɛli konim. Noko menli mɔɔ de bikye suakpole Gebɛyɔn la anzuzu zɔ. Bɛliele bɛlile kɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛko amaa Yizilayɛma, na bɛangulo kɛ bɛ nee Nyamenle kɛdwudwu. Ɔti ɛze mɔɔ Gebɛyɔnoma ne yɛle a?

Bɛbɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛbamaa yɛayɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛvi moamoa. Yemɔti mrenya ne mɔ bie wulale adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛtete kpasakpasa nee mgbɔlaboa dɛba mɔɔ ɛtete na bɛsosɔ bɛ la. Bɛvale ahodoku mɔɔ ɛyɛ dɛba na bɛteta nu la, nee kpanwo dɛba mɔɔ ɛyɛ reresee la bɛzoale bɛ asoaso ne mɔ. Akee bɛhɔle Dwɔhyua ɛkɛ na bɛzele ye kɛ: ‘Yɛvi moa kpalɛ a yɛra a, ɔluakɛ yɛde bɛ Nyamenle kpole, Gyihova ne nganeɛ. Yɛde ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔmanle bɛ wɔ Yigyibiti la amuala. Ɔti yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ zoanle yɛ kɛ yɛva aleɛ yɛzia yɛ nwo na yɛrayia bɛ na yɛha yɛhile bɛ kɛ: “Yɛle bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ. Bɛbɔ yɛ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛ nee yɛ ɛnrɛho.” Nea kɛzi yɛ adɛladeɛ ne ɛtete ɔlua adenle ne tendenle ti na yɛ kpanwo ne mɔ ɛzi ɛyɛ reresee, bɛbɔ adubue bie ɛ.’

Dwɔhyua ne ye mgbanyima ne mɔ liele Gebɛyɔnoma ne mɔ lile. Ɔti bɛbɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ ɛnrɛho. Noko ye kenle nsa ne azo bɛdele kɛ amuanrɛɛ Gebɛyɔnoma ne de bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala.

Dwɔhyua bizale bɛ kɛ: ‘Kɛmɔti yɛɛ bɛbɛlɛbɛla yɛ kɛ bɛvi moa a bɛrale ɛ?’

Gebɛyɔnoma ne buale kɛ: ‘Yɛyɛle ye zɔhane ɔboalekɛ yɛde kɛ Gyihova Nyamenle ɛze bɛ kɛ ɔbava Keena azɛlɛ ɛhye amuala yeamaa bɛ. Zɔhane ati ɛnee yɛsulo kɛ bɛkɛhu yɛ.’ Yizilayɛma ne lile bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne azo na bɛangu Gebɛyɔnoma ne. Emomu bɛyɛle bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ.

Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli ne vale ɛya kpole ɔluakɛ Gebɛyɔnoma nee Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ anzondwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ la ati. Yemɔti ɔzele arelemgbunli nna kɛ: ‘Bɛraboa me bɛmaa me nee Gebɛyɔnoma ɛhɔho.’ Na zɔhane ala yɛɛ arelemgbunli nnu ne yɛle a. Asoo nrɛlɛbɛ wɔ anzondwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Gebɛyɔnoma ne nee Yizilayɛma yɛle, mɔɔ ɛmaa arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ ɛlɛba araho la anu? Yɛbanwu ye.Dwɔhyua 9:1-27; 10:1-⁠5. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA Dwɔhyua. Ɔlɛka kɛ: ‘Sɛnzɛne, mmatu ɛ bo!’ Amgba sɛnzɛne ne gyinlanle. Ɔgyinlanle ɛleka ko kenle ko ne amuala. Gyihova a yɛle ye zɔ a! Noko maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti Dwɔhyua kulo kɛ sɛnzɛne ne kɔ zo gyinla la.

Mekɛ mɔɔ arelemgbunli nnu ne mɔɔ vi Keena azɛlɛ ne azo la bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛ nee Gebɛyɔnoma ne mɔ ko la, Gebɛyɔnoma ne zoanle awie kɛ ɔhɔvɛlɛ Dwɔhyua ɔmaa ɔraboa bɛ. Ɔse: ‘Bɛla ndɛndɛ! Balie yɛ ngoane! Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la ɛbɔ nu ɛra nee wɔ ngɛkɛlɛ baho.’

Ndɛndɛ ne ala Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hɔle. Bɛdiale nɔe ne toonwo bɛhɔle. Bɛdwule Gebɛyɔn la, ɛzulolɛ hanle arelemgbunli nnu ne ɛlɔnema ne na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛnriandi. Gyihova manle ezuawolɛ mgbole vi anwuma dɔle guale bɛ nwo zo, na menli mɔɔ ezuawolɛ ne hunle bɛ la zonle tɛla mɔɔ Dwɔhyua ɛlɔnema ne mɔ hunle bɛ la.

Dwɔhyua nwunle kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ sɛnzɛne ne badɔ. Awozinli bara, na arelemgbunli nnu ne ɛlɔnema ne bava bɛ nwo kɔlɔɔnwo anriandi. Ɛhye ati Dwɔhyua yɛle asɔne na ɔhanle ɔhilele Gyihova kɛ: ‘Sɛnzɛne, mmatu ɛ bo!’ Mekɛ mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne gyinlanle la, Yizilayɛma ne holale wiele bɛ konimlilɛ wɔ konle ne anu bɔkɔɔ.

Arelemgbunli atisesebɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ Keena azɛlɛ ne azo mɔɔ bɛkpɔ Nyamenle menli a. Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vale ɛvolɛ nsia na bɛahola bɛadu arelemgbunli 31 wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Bɛwiele la Dwɔhyua nleanle manle bɛhyehyɛle Keena azɛlɛ ne anu bɛmanle mbusua ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛnyianle azɛlɛ ne bie la.

Ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo anzi, Dwɔhyua wule wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ 110. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ de aze la, maanle ne diele Gyihova. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ menli mgbalɛ ɛhye mɔ wule la, menli ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛyɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ ɔnfɛta la na ɛhye manle bɛyiale ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee akee bɛhyia Nyamenle moalɛ amgba.Dwɔhyua 10:6-15; 12:7-24; 14:1-⁠5; Maanlebuvolɛma 2:8-13. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

SAA Yizilayɛma kɔ ngyegyelɛ nu a, bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ Gyihova. Gyihova dua adekilevolɛ akɛnrasesebɛma nwo zo boa bɛ. Baebolo ne fɛlɛ adekilevolɛma ɛhye mɔ ndɛnebuavolɛma. Dwɔhyua a le ndɛnebuavolɛ mɔɔ lumua a, na ndɛnebuavolɛma mɔɔ rale ɔ nzi la bie mɔ a le Ɔteneɛle, Yehɛde nee Hyamega. Noko menli mɔɔ boale Yizilayɛma la anu nwiɔ le mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Dɛbola nee Gyeeyɛle a. Dɛbola le ngapezonli raalɛ. Gyihova ka kenlebie edwɛkɛ kile ye, na ɔdaye noko ɔka mɔɔ Gyihova ɛha la ɔkile menli ne. Dɛbola eza le ndɛnebuavolɛ. Ɔta ɔtɛnla arɛlɛ bie abo wɔ awoka maanle ne ko anu, na menli badie bɛ ngyegyelɛ nwo moalɛ fi ye ɛkɛ.

Zɛhae mekɛ ye anu ɛnee Gyeeben a le Keenama belemgbunli a. Ɔlɛ konle mbulalɛ ehwili 900. Ɔluakɛ ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ anwo yɛ se la ati Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo rayɛle Gyeeben ngɛkɛlɛ. Gyeeben ɛlɔnema ne azo safohyenle kpanyinli a le Sesɛla.

Kenle ko Dɛbola zoanle manle bɛhɔvɛlɛle Ndɛnebuavolɛ Balake na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Gyihova se: “Fa mrenya 10,000 na kɔ Teebɔ Boka ne azo. Na mebava Sesɛla meayia wɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Na meamaa wɔali ɔ nee ye ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo konim.” ’

Balake buale Dɛbola kɛ: ‘Saa ɛ nee me kɛhɔ ɛdeɛ a, menwɔhɔ.’ Dɛbola nee ye hɔle, noko ɔzele Balake kɛ: ‘Ɛnrɛnyia ɛ nyunlu wɔ konimlilɛ ne anzi, ɔluakɛ Gyihova baye Sesɛla amaa raalɛzinli.’ Na kɛ ɔrale ye la ɛne.

Balake tolole Teebɔ Boka ne na ɔhɔyiale Sesɛla ɛlɔnema ne. Arɛlevilɛ nu ala Gyihova manle azuyilɛ vale kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema ne, na dɔɔnwo wule. Noko Sesɛla vi ye ehwili ne anu dwule na ɔ guale ndwɛlɛ aze.

Mekɛ hɔle bie la Sesɛla radwule Gyeeyɛle sua nu. Ɔvale ye ɔhɔle ɛdanlɛ sua ne anu na ɔmanle ye meleke ɔnlonle. Ɛhye manle ɔbɔle ngɔsɔkɛ, na yeangyɛ ɔlafele botoo. Akee Gyeeyɛle vale ɛdanlɛ sua ne mbaka adakola ne ko na ɔvale ɔbɔle nrenya ɛtanevolɛ ne ati anu kyengye ɔbetanle azɛlɛ ne anwo. Amozii, mekɛ mɔɔ Balake rale la, ɔhilele ye Sesɛla mɔɔ ɛwu la! Yemɔti mɔɔ Dɛbola hanle la rale nu pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Awieleɛ kolaa ne bɛhunle belemgbunli Gyeeben noko, na Yizilayɛma nyianle anzondwolɛ wɔ mekɛ ekyi anu.Maanlebuvolɛma 2:14-22; 4:1-24; 5:1-31. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

WƆ BAEBOLO ne anu ɛbanwu buluku bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Wulutu. Ɔka abusua bie mɔɔ dɛnlanle aze wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ndɛnebuavolɛma a sie Yizilayɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ. Wulutu le bɛlɛra mɔɔ vi Mowabe azɛlɛ zo; ɔmboka Nyamenle menli Yizilayɛma anwo. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ Wulutu zukoale nɔhalɛ Nyamenle Gyihova ne anwo debie la, ɔnyianle ɛhulolɛ kpole ɔmanle ye. Nawome le raalɛ kpanyinli mɔɔ boale Wulutu manle ɔzukoale Gyihova anwo debie a.

Nawome le Yizilayɛnli raalɛ. Ɔ nee ɔ hu yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya nwiɔ hɔdɛnlanle Mowabe azɛlɛ zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee aleɛ nwo ɛyɛ se wɔ Yizilayɛ la. Kenle ko Nawome ahu ne wule. Amozii Nawome amra mrenya ne mɔ gyale Mowabe mbɛlɛra nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Wulutu nee Ɔpa. Noko ye ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ 10 anzi, Nawome amra mrenya nwiɔ ne wule. Nea alɔbɔlɛ kpole mɔɔ Nawome nee mbɛlɛra nwiɔ ne lile a! Duzu a akee Nawome bayɛ a?

Kenle ko Nawome bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔtu adenle tendenle ne yeazia yeahɔ ye sua zo. Wulutu nee Ɔpa kulo kɛ bɛ nee ye tɛnla, ɔti bɛ nee ye hɔle. Noko bɛdwule adenle nu la, Nawome zele mbɛlɛra ne mɔ kɛ: ‘Bɛzia, awie biala ɛhɔ ɔ nli sua nu.’

Nawome vole bɛ nloa anwo na ɔhɛlale bɛ. Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛdukuele nu bɛzunle, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛkulo Nawome kpalɛ kpalɛ. Bɛzele kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ! Yɛ nee wɔ kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛvi la.’ Na Nawome buale bɛ kɛ: ‘Me mra mraalɛ, bɛzia bɛhɔ. Ɔbayɛ kpalɛ yeamaa bɛ wɔ bɛ sua zo.’ Ɔti Ɔpa ziale. Na Wulutu ɛdeɛ, yeamkponle kɛ ɔkɛzia.

Nawome hakyile ɔ nwo na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Ɔpa ɛzia ɛhɔ. Ɛdawɔ noko toa ye ɛ nee ye bɛhɔ.’ Noko Wulutu buale kɛ: ‘Mmafoa me kɛ mengyakyi wɔ mengɔ! Maa me nee wɔ ɛhɔ. Ɔluakɛ me nee wɔ yɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la, yɛɛ mebadɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkɛdɛnla la. Wɔ menli bayɛ me menli, na wɔ Nyamenle ne ayɛ me Nyamenle. Ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkɛwu la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ medame mebawu meala na bɛazie me a.’ Wulutu hanle ɛhye la Nawome andɛ ɔ nloa anu bieko kɛ ɔmaa yeazia.

Awieleɛ kolaa mraalɛ nwiɔ ne radwule Yizilayɛ. Ɛke yɛɛ bɛzokoɛle bɛdɛnlanle a. Ɔluakɛ ɔle aleɛ ɛpɛlɛ mekɛ la ati Wulutu bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔyɛ gyima wɔ ɛya ne mɔ anu. Nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Bowaze la manle ɔhuohuale ma wɔ ye ɛya ne anu. Asoo ɛze Bowaze ɔ nli ɔ? Ye mɔ a le Releehab mɔɔ vi Gyɛleko la.

Kenle ko Bowaze zele Wulutu kɛ: ‘Mede ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ nee kpalɛ mɔɔ wɔyɛ wɔmaa Nawome la kɔsɔɔti. Meze kɛzi wɔgyakyi ɛ ze nee ɛ nli ɛvi wɔ maanle nu wɔra menli mɔɔ ɛnze bɛ la avinli la, amuala. Gyihova ɛlo wɔ molozo!’

Wulutu buale kɛ: ‘Yɛmenle, wɔlo me somaa. Mɔɔ wɔha la ɛmaa me nye ɛlie na me rɛle ɛkyekye bɔkɔɔ.’ Ɛnee Bowaze kulo Wulutu kpalɛ, ɔti yeangyɛ yɛɛ bɛgyale bɛ nwo a. Nea kɛzi ɛhye manle Nawome anye liele a! Noko Nawome anyelielɛ ne yɛle kpole wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Wulutu nee Bowaze wole bɛ belamunli ralɛ nrenya ne, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Obɛde la. Amozii Obɛde rayɛle Devidi mɔɔ yɛbazukoa ɔ nwo debie dɔɔnwo nzinlii la nenya.Wulutu 1-4 Baebolo buluku ne. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

WƆNWU mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo wɔ ɛke la ɔ? Menli ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti le Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema. Menli mɔɔ ɛbutu la ɛlɛno nzule. Ndɛnebuavolɛ Gedɛyɔn a gyi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la. Ɔlɛnea kɛzi bɛlɛno nzule ne la.

Nea adenle ngakyile mɔɔ menli ne lua zo ɛlɛno nzule ne la. Bie mɔ ɛva bɛ nyunlu ɛbutu nzule ne anu. Noko ko ɛlɛfa ɔ sa yeave nzule ne amaa yeanwu mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo la amuala. Ɛhye hyia kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ Gyihova hanle hilele Gedɛyɔn kɛ ɔkpa menli mɔɔ bɛanlo nzule ne na mekɛ ko ne ala bɛazinza la. Menli mɔɔ ɛha la, Nyamenle se, bɛmaa bɛzia. Maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔrale ye zɔ la.

Yizilayɛma ɛnyia edwɛkɛ kpole bieko. Ɔboalekɛ bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi Gyihova. Medeanema ɛnyia tumi kpole ɛdɛla bɛ na bɛlɛkile bɛ nyane dɔɔnwo. Yemɔti Yizilayɛma zɛlɛle Gyihova moalɛ, na Gyihova diele bɛ ɛzunlɛ ne.

Gyihova hanle hilele Gedɛyɔn kɛ ɔkpondɛ ɛlɔnema, ɔti Gedɛyɔn boɔboale ɛlɔnema 32,000 anloa. Noko ɛlɔnema 135,000 yɛɛ ɛlɛba bɛ nee Yizilayɛma araho a. Noko akee Gyihova hanle hilele Gedɛyɔn kɛ: ‘Menli ne zonle somaa.’ Duzu ati a Gyihova hanle ye zɔ a?

Ɔboalekɛ saa Yizilayɛ di konim a bɛbaha kɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ mɔdenlebɔlɛ ɔ. Bɛbadwenle kɛ bɛangyia Gyihova moalɛ biala. Ɔti Gyihova zele Gedɛyɔn kɛ: ‘Ka kile awie biala mɔɔ ɔsulo la kɛ ɔzia ɔhɔ sua nu.’ Gedɛyɔn yɛle ye zɔ la menli 22,000 ziale hɔle sua nu. Ɔhale mrenya 10,000 mɔɔ bɛ nee ɛlɔnema 135,000 ne a kaho a.

Noko, tie! Gyihova se: ‘Ɛlɔne mɔɔ ɛha la tɛso somaa.’ Yemɔti ɔzele Gedɛyɔn kɛ ɔmaa menli ne mɔ ɛnlo nzule wɔ azudenle ɛhye anu na ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛ nyunlu bɛkɛbutu nzule ne anu la amuala ɛzia ɛhɔ sua nu. Gyihova bɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ: ‘Mebamaa menli 300 ne mɔɔ vale bɛ sa venle nzule ne nlonle la nee wɔ ali konim.’ Konle mekɛ ne dwule zo. Gedɛyɔn hyɛle ye menli 300 ne mɔ anu ekpunli nsa. Na ɔvale aweɛne, nee dwora mɔɔ tɛkɛ zia nu la ɔmanle awie ko biala. Ɔkɔ ne alevinli-nwiɔ-avinli la, bɛbɛngale bɛ agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ azokoɛleɛ ne anwo bɛyiale. Akee bɛwule bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ anu na bɛbobɔle dwora ne mɔ, na bɛdeanle nu kɛ: ‘Konle ne le Gyihova nee Gedɛyɔn ɛdeɛ!’ Mekɛ mɔɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛlɔne ne dwazole la bɛ ahonle dule na bɛyɛle basaa. Bɛ muala bɛguale ɛbɔ nu, na Yizilayɛma lile konim.Maanlebuvolɛma tile 6 kɔdwu 8. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

WƆBƆ ɛwɔkɛ bie mɔɔ akee amozii ɛnwunle kɛ ɔyɛ se kɛ ɛkɛli zolɛ la ɛlɛ ɔ? Zɔhane a ɛdo nrenya ne mɔɔ wɔ nvoninli ɛhye anu la, na yemɔti a ɔlɛdi alɔbɔlɛ a. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛfeta na ɔle Yizilayɛ ndɛnebuavolɛ mɔɔ lɛ akɛnrasesebɛ a.

Gyɛfeta dɛnlanle aze wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛgyakyi Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ la. Bɛbɔle ɔ bo bɛyɛle ninyɛndane bieko. Ɔti Gyihova manle Amɔnoma duale bɛ kakɛ soo. Ɛhye manle Yizilayɛma zunle vɛlɛle Gyihova kɛ: ‘Yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ. Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, die yɛ!’

Menli ne nlunle bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo. Akee bɛbɔle ɔ bo bɛzonlenle Gyihova bieko. Ɔti Gyihova boale bɛ bieko.

Menli ne yele Gyɛfeta manle ɔ nee Amɔnoma honle. Ɛnee Gyɛfeta kulo kɛ Gyihova boa ye wɔ konle ne anu. Yemɔti ɔbɔle Gyihova ɛwɔkɛ kɛ: ‘Saa ɛmaa medi Amɔnoma anwo zo konim, na mesia meara sua nu, na awie biala mɔɔ kɛlumua kɛvi me sua nu ɛkɛ ne kɛvinde kɛ ɔbayia me la, mebava ye meamaa wɔ.’ Gyihova diele Gyɛfeta ɛwɔkɛ ne na ɔboale ye ɔmanle ɔlile konim. Gyɛfeta sia ara sua nu la, ɛze awie mɔɔ lumuale kɛ ɔbayia ye ɔ? Ɔ ra raalɛ ne, mɔɔ le ɔ ra kokye la ɔ. Gyɛfeta deanle nu kɛ: ‘Oo me ra! Duzu ati a wɔde me ɛbolɛ kpole zɛhae ɛ? Noko mebɔ Gyihova ɛwɔkɛ, na metwe mesia a ɔnyɛ boɛ.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛfeta ara raalɛ ne dele ye ɛwɔkɛ ne la, mɔlebɛbo ne ɔdaye noko ɔrɛle bɔle. Ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɛwɔkɛ ne kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfi ɔ ze nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ amuala anwo. Na ye ngoane mekɛ muala anu ɔbazonle Gyihova wɔ ye ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Hyaelo la anu. Yemɔti ɔzele ɔ ze kɛ: ‘Saa wɔbɔ Gyihova ɛwɔkɛ a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdi zolɛ.’

Ɔti Gyɛfeta ara raalɛ ne hɔle Hyaelo, na ɔzonlenle wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu wɔ ye ngoane mekɛ muala anu. Ɛvolɛ biala dwu a Yizilayɛ mraalɛ kɔkpɔla ye wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu kenle nna, na bɛbɔ nu bɛdie bɛ nye. Menli ne hulole Gyɛfeta ara raalɛ ne edwɛkɛ ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle Gyihova sonvolɛ kpalɛ.Maanlebuvolɛma 10:6-18; 11:1-40. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Nrenya Mɔɔ Anwo Yɛ Se Kpalɛ
data.contenido:
ƐZE nrenya bie mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛdɛnla aze ɛlɛ la duma ɔ? Ɔle ndɛnebuavolɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Samesɛn. Gyihova a manle Samesɛn anwosesebɛ a. Kolaa na bawo Samesɛn bɔbɔ la, Gyihova hanle hilele ɔ nli kɛ: ‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ ɛbawo ralɛ nrenya. Na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbalie Yizilayɛma yeavi Filisitiama asa nu a.’

Filisitiama le ɛtanevolɛma mɔɔ de Keena. Bɛlɛ ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo, na bɛgyegyele Yizilayɛma kpalɛ. Kenle ko mɔɔ Samesɛn lua adenle nu ɔlɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Filisitiama ne mɔ de la, ɔnwunle kɛ awenade kpole bie ɛlɛkpo arayia ye. Na Samesɛn vale ɔ sa mgbane hunle awenade ne. Eza ɔhunle Filisitiama mɔɔ di ɛtane la anu ɛya ɛya dɔɔnwo.

Amozii Samesɛn nwunle raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dɛlaela la na ɔhulole ye. Filisitiama mgbanyima bɔle Dɛlaela ɛwɔkɛ kɛ saa ɔkola ɔkile debie mɔɔ maa Samesɛn anwo yɛ se la a bɛ nuhua ko biala bamaa ye dwɛtɛ fufule 1,100. Dɛlaela kulo kɛ ɔnyia ezukoa ɛhye amuala. Ɛnee ɔnle Samesɛn anzɛɛ Nyamenle menli agɔnwo kpalɛ. Yemɔti ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔbizale Samesɛn alehyenlɛ ko biala kɛ ɔhile ye deɛ mɔɔ maa ɔ nwo yɛ se la.



Awieleɛ kolaa ne, Samesɛn hanle ɛleka mɔɔ ye anwosesebɛ ne wɔ la ɔhilele Dɛlaela. Ɔse: ‘Dadeɛ dɛma ɛtɛkanle me ti enrinli ɛlɛ. Ɔluakɛ ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwole me la, Nyamenle kpale me kɛ ye sonvolɛ titile mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Tusiemaa-Nyamenle anzɛɛ Nazalaete. Saa bɛkpa me ti enrinli ne a me anwosesebɛ ne bavi me nu.’

Dɛlaela dele ye zɔ la ɔmanle Samesɛn lafele ɔ gyakɛ azo. Akee ɔvɛlɛle nrenya bie ɔmanle ɔrakpale ɔ ti enrinli ne. Samesɛn vi nlafelɛ nu dwazole la, ɛnee ye anwosesebɛ ne ɛvi ye nu. Filisitiama ne rale na bɛrahyele ye. Bɛdudule ɔ nye nwiɔ ne, na bɛyɛle ye bɛ akɛlɛ.



Kenle ko Filisitiama ne yiale dole ɛkponle kpole bie manle bɛ nyamenle Deegɔn, na bɛvale Samesɛn bɛrale kɛ bɛgolo ɔ nwo. Zɔhane mekɛ ne ɛnee Samesɛn ati enrinli ne ɛvi bieko. Samesɛn hanle hilele kakula nrenya ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ɔ sa ɔlɛkile ye adenle la kɛ: ‘Maa mensosɔ mpila ne mɔɔ lɛ sua ye la anu.’ Akee Samesɛn zɛlɛle Gyihova kɛ ɔmaa ye anwosesebɛ, na ɔzɔle mpila ne mɔ anu. Ɔdeanle nu kɛ: ‘Maa me nee Filisitiama ye ɛwu.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ Samesɛn tiale mpila ne mɔ la, ɔbule ɔguale Filisitiama 3,000 mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkponledolɛ ne abo la anwo zo na ɔhunle ɛtanevolɛma ɛhye mɔ amuala.Maanlebuvolɛma tile 13 kɔdwu 16. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

KAKULA ɛhye anwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Samoɛle. Yizilayɛma ɛsɔfo kpanyinli Yilae a ɛva ɔ sa yedo Samoɛle ati zo la. Samoɛle ɔ ze Ɛlekana nee ɔ nli Hana yɛɛ ɛlɛfa Samoɛle arɛlɛ Yilae la.

Samoɛle ɛli ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ nna anzɛɛ nnu. Noko akee ɔ nee Yilae nee ɛsɔfoma mɔɔ ɛha la badɛnla Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ye anu. Duzu ati a Ɛlekana nee Hana bava kakula ekyi le kɛ Samoɛle la kɛ ɔrazonle wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu ɛ? Maa yɛnlea.

Ɛvolɛ ekyi mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la ɛ ɛnee Hana arɛle ɛbɔ. Ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔnwo, na ɛnee ɔlɛkpondɛ ralɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ. Yemɔti kenle ko mɔɔ Hana hɔle Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la, ɔzɛlɛle kɛ: ‘O Gyihova, mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi me! Mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ saa ɛmaa menyia ralɛ a mebava ye meamaa wɔ amaa yeazonle wɔ dahuu.’

Gyihova diele Hana nzɛlɛlɛ ne, ɔti mekɛ ekyi guale nu la ɔwole Samoɛle. Hana hulole ɔ ra ekyi ne edwɛkɛ, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkile ye Gyihova anwo edwɛkɛ mekɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔtɛde ekyi la. Ɔzele ɔ hu kɛ: ‘Saa Samoɛle pɛ nyɛfonlɛ na ɔ nwo kputi a mebava ye meahɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu na yeazonle Gyihova wɔ ɛkɛ ne.’

Ɛhye a Hana nee Ɛlekana ɛlɛyɛ ye wɔ nvoninli ne anu la. Ɔluakɛ Samoɛle awovolɛ ɛhilehile ye kpalɛ la ati, ɔ nye ɛlie kɛ ɔbahola yeazonle Gyihova wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Ɛvolɛ biala Hana nee Ɛlekana basonle wɔ ɛdanlɛ sua titile ɛhye anu, na bɛkpɔla bɛ ra nrenya ekyi ne. Na ɛvolɛ biala Hana fa aguzo mɔɔ yekpomgba la ɔbɛlɛ Samoɛle.

Samoɛle hɔle zo zonlenle wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu, na Gyihova nee menli ne hulole ye edwɛkɛ. Noko ɛsɔfo kpanyinli Yilae amra mrenya Hɔfenae nee Fenɛhaze ɛnle kpalɛ fee. Bɛyɛ ninyɛndane dɔɔnwo, na bɔbɔ bɛtwehwe awie mɔ bɛmaa bɛyɛ Gyihova anwo anzosesebɛ. Ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Yilae ye bɛ fi ɛsɔfo ɛlile ne azo, noko akee yeanyɛ ye zɔ.

Kakula Samoɛle ammaa ninyɛndane mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkɔ zo wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la anzi ye aze wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ nwo. Noko ɔluakɛ menli ekyi bie a ɛnee lɛ Gyihova anwo ɛhulolɛ la ati, ɛnee Gyihova nee dasanli dendɛle la ɛhyɛ kpalɛ. Mekɛ mɔɔ Samoɛle nyinli ekyii la mɔɔ ɔzile la ɛne:

Ɛnee Samoɛle ɛlafe wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu na ɛnelɛ bie manle ɔdunwuele. Ɔbuale kɛ: ‘Mewɔ ɛke.’ Ɔdwazole na ɔnriandile ɔhɔle Yilae ɛkɛ ne, na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Ɛvɛlɛle me, mera.’

Na Yilae zele ye kɛ: ‘Metɛfɛlɛle wɔ na kɔla.’ Yemɔti Samoɛle ziale hɔlale.

Ɛnelɛ ne rale mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la kɛ: ‘Samoɛle!’ Yemɔti Samoɛle dwazole na ɔnriandile ɔhɔle Yilae ɛkɛ. Ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Ɛvɛlɛle me, mame ɛne!’ Noko Yilae buale ye kɛ: ‘Me ra, metɛfɛlɛle wɔ. Sia kɔla bieko.’ Ɔti Samoɛle ziale hɔlale.

Ye fane nsa ne azo ɛnelɛ ne vɛlɛle bieko: ‘Samoɛle!’ Eza Samoɛle dwazole na ɔhɔle Yilae anwo ɛkɛ. Na ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ: ‘Mera, ɔluakɛ ɛvɛlɛle me.’ Yilae nwunle kɛ Gyihova yɛɛ ɛlɛfɛlɛ ye a. Yemɔti ɔzele Samoɛle kɛ: ‘Kɔ kɔla bieko, na saa ɔfɛlɛ wɔ bieko a, ka kɛ: “Gyihova, tendɛ na wɔ sonvolɛ ɛlɛtie.”’

Ɛhye yɛɛ Samoɛle yɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyihova vɛlɛle ye bieko la. Akee Gyihova hanle hilele Samoɛle kɛ ɔbadea Yilae nee ɔ mra ne mɔ. Amozii Hɔfenae nee Fenɛhaze wule wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Filisitiama ɛlɛko la, na Yilae dele amaneɛ ne la ɔdɔle aze, na ɔ kɔme bule na ɔdaye noko ɔwule. Ɔti Gyihova edwɛkɛ ne rale nu pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Samoɛle yɛle kpanyinli, na ɔrayɛle Yizilayɛ ndɛnebuavolɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɛrelera la, menli ne zele ye kɛ: ‘Ye sonla maa ɔli yɛ nwo zo belemgbunli.’ Samoɛle angulo kɛ ɔkɛyɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Gyihova a le bɛ belemgbunli a. Noko Gyihova zele ye kɛ ɔdie menli ne.1 Samoɛle 1:1-28; 2:11-36; 3:1-18; 4:16-18; 8:4-⁠9. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
